privileged_info_for_vlm: The required Clearance Departments are: 'IT & Devices', 'Facilities', and 'Financial Accounts'. The required Question Categories are: 'Work Environment' and 'Compensation'. The specific questions to be mapped are: 1. 'Did you feel you were equipped with the necessary tools to perform your job?' (Work Environment), 2. 'How would you rate the physical working conditions?' (Work Environment), 3. 'Do you feel your compensation was competitive with the market?' (Compensation), 4. 'Were you satisfied with the benefits package provided?' (Compensation). All other pre-existing questions must be removed or deactivated.
